data.creative: Aussie boy: warts burned off 7 times, then a little bottle · 719197644509837
data.hook: I've had my warts burned off seven times, nothing happened.
data.desire: Get rid of my kid's warts after repeated burning did nothing, without pain.
data.angle: A boy who failed seven clinical burn-offs vs a little bottle at home.
data.belief_shift: from 'burning them off is the only option, even if it keeps failing' → to 'a little bottle at home cleared them in about a month without pain' (advertiser's claim)
data.script_structure: Boy: burned off 7 times, embarrassed at school → little bottle, a bit of that → foot photos, lost them in a month → dad: no burning, no pain, unbelievable → VO: works on all wart types (animation, hand, face) → 'thousands of Aussie moms', 1-2 weeks → kids love it, no sting, at home → guarantee → PDP review scroll → CTA
data.mechanism_reveal: None beyond 'works on all types of warts'.
data.proof: Boy's failed-effort testimonial at 0:00-0:19; foot photos at 0:10-0:13; dad's endorsement at 0:20-0:24; wart-type visuals at 0:25-0:30; 'thousands of Aussie moms' and 1-2 weeks claim at 0:29-0:34; guarantee at 0:38; PDP before/after and review scroll with 'thousands of 5-star reviews' at 0:42-0:46.
data.cta: 'Check out H-Warts Formula today and help your kids be wart-free.' 90-day money-back guarantee.
data.why_it_works: Interpretation of execution, not measured performance: A specific number of failed treatments ('seven times') makes the pain of past effort concrete, and hearing it from a kid with his dad beside him is hard to dismiss. The voiceover half then widens it to many families and adds the guarantee.
data.transferable_move: Open with the end user stating exactly how many times the standard fix failed, add a second family member's one-line endorsement, then switch to voiceover for coverage, social proof and guarantee. Soften: 'skin looks clearer' rather than 'wart-free'.
data.opening_visual: Boy in a Cowboys rugby jersey holding a cotton bud and bottle against a white wall; caption 'I've had my warts burned off 7 times'.
data.transition_to_product: 0:07.6-0:10 'Just a little bottle right here with a little bit of that gets it off', bottle held up.
data.proof_placement: Foot photos follow 'maybe a month'; dad's line follows 'all gone'; crowd claim and reviews follow the wart-types beat; guarantee precedes the review scroll.
